sections.title: 1. Free plan
sections.body: The Free plan costs nothing and never requires payment there is nothing to refund.

sections.title: 2. Monthly plans
sections.body: Starter ($2.99/month) and Pro ($7.99/month) renew automatically each month. You can cancel anytime in Settings → Billing & History, you keep access until the end of the current billing period, and you will not be charged again.

sections.title: 3. Refund eligibility
list: Within 7 days of your first payment on a new plan, you can request a full refund if you have not used more than 20% of that month's smart allowance
Accidental duplicate charges are refunded in full
Refunds are not provided for partial months after the 7-day window, or for normal use of smart features

sections.title: 4. Annual plans
sections.body: Annual plans can be refunded on a prorated basis for unused full months remaining, minus any smart usage beyond the free-plan allowance.

sections.title: 5. How to request a refund
sections.body: Contact us with your account email and the date of the charge see the Contact page. We aim to respond within 2 business days and process approved refunds to your original payment method (KHQR or Stripe) within 5–10 business days.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you give us directly: your name, email, phone number, and the content of any resume you build with ResuMate (work history, education, skills, and similar details).
list: Account info you provide when you sign in with Google
Resume content you type or paste, including job advertisements you analyze
Usage data such as pages visited and features used, to improve the product

sections.title: 2. How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to build and store your resumes, run smart features (job analysis, match scoring, interview questions, readiness reports), process payments, and improve ResuMate. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Smart processing
sections.body: Resume content and pasted job advertisements may be sent to our smart providers to generate suggestions, scores, and questions. This content is used only to serve your request and is not used to train shared models without your consent.

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We share data only with service providers who help us run ResuMate, such as payment processors (Stripe, Bakong/KHQR) and cloud hosting, under confidentiality obligations. We may disclose information if required by law.

sections.title: 5. Data retention & control
sections.body: You can edit or delete your resumes and account at any time from Settings. Deleting your account removes your personal data and stored resumes within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it by contacting us; see the Contact page.

sections.title: 7. Contact us
sections.body: Questions about this policy? Reach us at privacy@resumate.app or visit our Contact page.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using ResuMate, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.title: 2. Your account
list: You sign in with Google; you are responsible for keeping that account secure
You must be at least 16 years old to use ResuMate
One account per person; accounts created to abuse free templates or trials may be suspended

sections.title: 3. Subscriptions & billing
sections.body: Starter and Pro plans are billed monthly or annually and renew automatically until cancelled in Settings → Billing & History. Payments are processed via KHQR or Stripe. See our Refund Policy for cancellation and refund terms.

sections.title: 4. Your content & acceptable use
list: You own the resumes and other content you create; we only use it to provide and improve the service
Smart suggestions are provided as a starting point; you are responsible for reviewing accuracy before use
Do not upload unlawful, infringing, or abusive content, or attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, or scrape the platform

sections.title: 5. Service availability & disclaimer
sections.body: ResuMate is provided "as is." We work to keep the platform reliable but do not guarantee uninterrupted access, and we are not liable for job outcomes, interview results, or decisions made by employers.

sections.title: 6. Changes & contact
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after a change means you accept the update. Questions? Reach out on the Contact page.

hero.title: Built in Cambodia,
hero.subtitle: ResuMate started with a simple frustration: too many talented students were paying strangers on Facebook just to get a resume that they couldn't even edit afterward.

story.label: Why we started
story.title: The $2.99 problem nobody
story.p1: Every year, thousands of students graduate from universities across Cambodia ready to start their careers. But there is a quiet barrier between them and their first job application: the resume.
story.p2: Without an affordable, locally built tool, most job seekers turn to informal resume writers on Facebook and Telegram paying two to six dollars each time, waiting days for a draft, and ending up with a file they cannot edit themselves when something needs to change.
story.quote: "We didn't want to build another resume tool. We wanted to build the tool we wished existed when we were applying for our first jobs."
story.p3: That's why ResuMate exists free to start, bilingual, smart-assisted, and always yours to keep, edit, and reuse. And now it goes further: not just building a resume, but helping you understand exactly how ready you are for any specific job you apply to.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: Make a great resume accessible to every
mission.subtitle: We believe where you went to university or how confident your English is shouldn't decide whether you get a fair shot at a job interview.

cards.title: Affordable for everyone
cards.desc: A generous free plan and Pro pricing built around what a Cambodian student can actually afford not US software pricing.

cards.title: Built for two languages
cards.desc: Read every instruction in Khmer or English, while your resume content stays in English exactly what employers expect.

cards.title: Beyond the resume
cards.desc: Most platforms stop once the resume is done. ResuMate continues analyzing job ads, matching your skills, and preparing you for the interview.

items.title: Free should mean free
items.desc: No surprise paywall before downloading. Our free plan gives a real, usable resume not a teaser that locks the PDF until you pay.

items.title: Built for Cambodia first
items.desc: Every template, price, and payment method (KHQR, Stripe Payment) is designed around how Cambodians actually work and pay not adapted from a US product.

items.title: Guidance over judgment
items.desc: If you have no work experience, we don't leave you stuck with a blank form. We show you exactly what counts and help you write it in professional English.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.desc: Your resume is always editable, exportable, and under your control never locked into our platform. Download it once and it is yours forever.

founder.label: Who's behind it
founder.title: A solo project,

founder.bio: A Bachelor of Software Engineering student in Multimedia at Limkokwing University Cambodia, building ResuMate as a final year project rooted in a real problem seen across Cambodian university campuses and a belief that good design, smart assistance, and career readiness tools should not be reserved for expensive Western platforms.

tips: Use an email and phone number you actually check recruiters reach out here first.
Start each bullet with an action verb and add a number where you can, e.g. "increased sales by 20%".
List your most recent degree first, and only include your GPA if it's strong.
Pick skills that match the job description quality beats a long list.
Read your resume out loud once before saving. It's the fastest way to catch typos.
